issue.body:
Closes #20119
Partially addresses #20438 


Aligned ai-label with invalid/warn states styling with design spec for `_list-box.scss` styles and aligned the web-components multi-select styles with react/design spec .

### Changelog

**New**

- Added styles to the web components version of multi-select to align with the design spec, due to many styles in `_list-box.scss` not being inherited properly
- Added controls to every MultiSelect story in React and Web Components


**Changed**

- Tweaked styles in `_list-box.scss` to better align with the design spec for MultiSelect:
    - Added a vertical line between the invalid/warn icon and the ai-label
    - Tweaked spacing
- These list-box style changes should also align `Dropdown` and `ComboBox` with the design spec for this case

**Removed**
- Removed the following stories from React Storybook as they don't seem necessary 
    - `MultiSelect/Filterable Controlled with Select All`
    - `MultiSelect/Multi Select Controlled with Select All`

#### Testing / Reviewing

- Go to MultiSelect in React storybook
- Invalid/warn states with ai-label should fit design spec
- Check other states too, there should be no regression
    - I've added controls to every story so that reviewing these changes is easier
- Go to MultiSelect in Web Components storybook
- Styles should match React and the design spec
    - Padding, positioning, placement, should all be good
    - I've added controls to every story so that reviewing these changes is easier
- Check `Dropdown` and `Combobox` for when they have an invalid/warn state with an AI-Label
- There should be no regression for any affected components: MultiSelect, Dropdown (React), ComboBox (React)

## PR Checklist

As the author of this PR, before marking ready for review, confirm you:

- [X] Reviewed every line of the diff
- [X] Updated documentation and storybook examples
- ~~[ ] Wrote passing tests that cover this change~~
- [X] Addressed any impact on accessibility (a11y)
- [X] Tested for cross-browser consistency
- [X] Validated that this code is ready for review and status checks should pass

data.body:
AI label story:

- It does not have the blue AI styling/colors appearing on the input.
- There needs to be a divider between the AI decorator and the chevron in the input.
- When the close icon appears in the input, the spacing is off and there should be a divider between the AI decorator and the close icon in the input.

- Do you **support multiple languages** in the same project? **Yes**
- Can you **group coverage reports** by project and/or test type? **Yes**

issue.body:
Closes #18332

Update `<cds-dropdown>` Web Component to match React component parity.

### Changelog

**New**

- Added keyboard navigation support (`ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `Enter`, `Space`)
- Added hover and focus highlight handling on dropdown items
- Added new Storybook stories and controls aligned with React

**Changed**

- Refactored internal dropdown logic to match React behavior for open/close, selection, and keyboard interactions
- Updated event handling for consistency (`cds-dropdown-beingselected`, `cds-dropdown-beingtoggled`, etc.)
- Updated CSS and token usage for parity with React (spacing, borders, hover and focus outlines)
- Updated Storybook to use `args` and `argTypes`
- Refactored rendering of dropdown menu and trigger to match React implementation
- Fixed invalid icon is on the wrong side when using AI-Label
- Fixed tests in dropdown and multi-select

**Removed**

- Removed outdated SCSS rules related to list-box outlines and helper text placement

#### Testing / Reviewing

1. Go to `WC Deploy Preview` > `Dropdown`compare with the React `Dropdown`.
2. Verify all controls and props (`disabled`, `invalid`, `warn`, `readOnly`, `size`, `type`...) behave consistently. (I open a separate issue to implement the autoAlign prop).
3. Test keyboard interactions:
   - `Enter` and `Space` open/close and select items
   - `ArrowUp` and `ArrowDown` navigate between items
4. Check that focus and hover visuals align with React behavior.
5. Review the following Storybook stories for accuracy:
   - Default
   - Experimental Auto Align (I just added the story, there's an issue open https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/issues/18332?issue=carbon-design-system%7Ccarbon%7C20859 to implement `autoAlign`)
   - Inline
   - Inline With Layer
   - Skeleton
   - With AI Label
   - With Layer
   - With Toggletip Label

## PR Checklist
